name: Systematic Industries Ltd

Same deal already flagged 'high' significance on 9-Sep-2026 (funded by an insider-heavy Rs33.94cr preferential issue) -- today fixes the exact SPA date and per-share price

No independent valuation or target financials disclosed in this filing -- governance scrutiny warranted given the related-party nature. Watch for WBIPL financials in next consolidated results.

name: Delta Corp Ltd
headline: Rs319.6cr GST provision swings Delta Corp standalone Q2FY27 to a loss -- SC casino-tax demand crystallizes far below the Rs16,823cr+ show-cause ceiling
thesisChain: Supreme Court's 27-May-2026 judgment on casino/online-gaming GST settles the valuation basis for long-pending show-cause notices (originally up to ~Rs16,823cr + Rs6,384cr + Rs1,884cr across entities/periods)
Adjudication orders under Rule 31C determine casino-transaction GST demand at Rs78.56cr and mixed-supply demand at Rs93.80cr for Jul2017-Mar2022
Extending the same basis through Sep2023/Sep2025, the company books a cumulative Rs319.60cr provision (incl. interest) -- Rs200.62cr already taken in Q1FY27, balance in Q2FY27
Standalone Q2FY27 EPS swings to Rs(2.99) vs +Rs0.84 YoY; H1FY27 EPS Rs(7.07) vs +Rs1.80 YoY
Company already paid ~Rs49cr principal post-quarter, plans to contest the balance; separately no longer needs to indemnify Head Digital Works for DGL's GST exposure

epsImpact.magnitude: Q2FY27 standalone EPS swings to ~Rs(2.99) from +Rs0.84 YoY on a one-time Rs319.6cr exceptional GST provision

insight: FOLLOW-UP that quantifies a risk flagged 'high' on 28-Sep-2026 (then a Rs116.4cr differential demand) -- today's actual P&L hit is larger: Rs319.60cr cumulative GST provision across Q1+Q2 FY27, following Supreme Court-settled adjudication orders. Swings standalone Q2FY27 to a loss (EPS Rs(2.99) vs +Rs0.84 YoY). The final provisioned number is dramatically smaller than the theoretical worst case (north of Rs16,800cr across entities) once feared, so this is also a tail-risk de-risking event despite driving this quarter's headline loss. Watch further adjudication orders and any litigation-driven reduction in a future quarter.
